title: Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions
main_claim: For fixed d and rational eps>0 there is N(d,eps) such that every eps-lc Fano contraction X->Z of dimension d (char 0) has, near each closed z in Z, a klt complement B with N(K_X+B) ~ 0 Cartier. The proof goes through Chen's equivalence with a uniform lower bound lct(X; m_z O_X) >= c(d,eps) in the birational, boundary-zero, Fano type case. A corollary claims the finite-rational-coefficient form of Shokurov's bounded klt complement conjecture.

issues.location: reduction.tex, Lemma lem:threshold-to-complement and proof of Corollary cor:finite-coefficients
issues.description: The whole reduction depends on Chen (arXiv:2403.01154v5), Theorem 1.6, implications (4)=>(1) and (2)=>(1), used with boundary coefficient set {0}. For the Corollary with a finite coefficient set I, only item (2) for boundary-zero, relatively nef data is checked. That is enough only if Chen's item (2) is stated just for zero boundary, or if his equivalence derives the I-version from the {0}-version. Chen's abstract states the local conjecture for eps-lc pairs (X,B), not only for varieties. I could not access the theorem text to confirm this, so this is a dependency to verify, not a demonstrated error.
issues.evidence: "Apply the implication (4)=>(1) in [Chen, Theorem 1.6], for every base-dimension bound needed and with boundary coefficient set {0}"; Corollary proof: "We check item (2) ... For its boundary-zero, relatively nef data ... The implication (2)=>(1) of his theorem gives the assertion, with the stated dependence on I."

coverage: Read in full and checked: introduction, the reduction section (threshold-to-complement, field descent including the strict inequality 1+a_E>q_E/b, ample model, Birkar n-complement setup), the initial cone section (canonical cone, Gaussian discrepancy, the fixed-index hypersurface lemma, the centred lc place eq A2, with all inequalities rechecked), the constrained-minimum section (minimizer comparison A3 and the exact-penalization contradiction (C+t'a_D)(u) - K t' a_D(w) >= C(u)(1 - C_2 t' a_D(w))), the essential-system section (A7 derivation, quotient S, Gauss lifts and coefficients, weak-essentiality objective comparison 1+lambda(c0-1) vs 1, and the angular identity A13 rederived), and rank-growth in full (layer dimension, rank increase, slopes, integral rounding, bounded divisorial index, final eps/(3C12) bookkeeping giving A_X(E) < eps). Also checked: the trace-lifting inequality E8 and the Takagi/Schwede proof of trace existence (Chevalley argument for large primes p = 1 mod n k_I), the start of cheap-collapse including the translated-box-count lemma, and parts of width-estimates (C7/C8, actual probes) and bounded-axes (pure descent, the row bounds were rederived). Only skimmed or not read: compatible-filtrations, discrepancy-push, scale-tower (the MMP tower and its inheritance), most of width-estimates (twist saturation, class lattices), the guard-model, marked-family and slow-charge parts of bounded-axes, the rest of cheap-collapse (exact zero, two-sided bounds F3-F5), the valuation-optimization skeleton and compactness, and the finite-data reduction in trace-lifting. Since this is a roughly 7,800-line proof of a major conjecture, about half of the technical middle was not verified line by line; the no_gap verdict carries low confidence for those parts.
sibling_notes: The board hive:oai_math:review:fam:066 was empty when I checked, so there were no sibling reports. The companion paper 'Uniform Cartier sections for Fano type contractions' is cited only as independent related work and is not used in the proof, so there is no circular dependence.
